verdict.rationale: AutoGen is itself the official SDK (autogen-agentchat, autogen-ext) with extensive first-party documentation covering installation, agents, teams, tools, memory, and migration guides, plus GitHub-hosted install instructions and community corroboration of hands-on usage. missing for 10: independent third-party API reference/versioning audit and confirmation of OpenAPI/machine-readable docs (probes show 404s for llms.txt and openapi.json).
